dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Golden Comet and Silver Companion, may everything go your way in the days ahead. Remember, you're welcome to come back and meet up with us anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon feels like... Never mind our first meeting, Haniyyah. You've changed from the last time we met in Fontaine. You're more noble, elegant... and more considerate!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Is that so? Perhaps it's the combined influence of Souka, Mr. Balfour, and Miss Najah...
